notes.title: The Demo Is Out !!!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45277168/85bad66e2f443a859e870cca1b3dfa6f71073ba5.jpg"]

Hello, explorers! I hope everyone is doing great! Today we are finally launching the first public early version of the game!
  Are you ready to play The Last Worlds : Crossed Souls ?

The demo version 0.1.1 is finally live on Steam and the planet Ness-444 is waiting to be explored! 

Please keep in mind this is our first public early version of the game and that this is only the beginning of The Last Worlds , also in the upcoming months we will add tons of content and new stuff to the game , totally for free!
We would love to receive all of the possible feedback from you guys and if you encounter any bug , please consider joining our Discord Server 

We want to shape this game with the help of everyone , every single idea and opinion you have matters , having you sharing your ideas/improvement will be crucial for The Last Worlds!
Just a reminder: our Kickstarter campaign launches on October 1, 2025 where you can partecipate directly in the game development by creating missions , armor and weapons , enemies and much more , also you can get time-limited rewards , you can wishlist for the campaign so that you will not miss it :


- Kickstarter Campaign Link - 

Click Here For The Kickstarter Page

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45277168/bf430cca53f8eb845a2e11f88577816bdf93e18c.jpg"]
Thank you for your attention! We can't wait to see you playing The Last Worlds!

notes.title: Early Access Demo Release Date
notes.content:
[previewyoutube="YFbJDMeLGgI;full"][/previewyoutube]

Hello, explorers! How's everyone doing? 

This is our first Steam Update, and we're here with exciting news!
 
The big news is that you can finally play The Last Worlds : Crossed Souls ! 
Mark your calendars for September 16, 2025, the release date for the first playable DEMO. 

We’ve put in a lot of effort to create the best game with our current resources. 
The Lupio Studios TEAM has grown to seven members, and we plan to expand to at least ten in the future! 


We look forward to hearing about your experiences with our game. 
Your support has made this possible, and we value your feedback to help us improve! 

Just a reminder: our Kickstarter campaign launches on October 1, 2025 where you can partecipate directly in the game development by creating missions , armor and weapons , enemies and much more , also you can get time-limited rewards , you can wishlist for the campaign so that you will not miss it :


- Kickstarter Campaign Link - 

Click Here For The Kickstarter Page

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45277168/d6f6c00f680ffbbfedcbe58b318dca47f04944fe.jpg"]
Thank you for your attention! We can't wait to see you playing The Last Worlds!
